title: AqUavplant: UAV-based Aquatic Plant Dataset
description: High-resolution UAV dataset for aquatic plant classification and semantic segmentation, collected from diverse water bodies in Bangladesh. Enables research in precision agriculture and environmental monitoring.

title: Real-time Obstacle Detection for Unmanned Ground Vehicles
description: YOLOv8-based real-time obstacle detection system for autonomous ground vehicles. Achieves high accuracy at low latency suitable for deployment on edge devices in dynamic outdoor environments.

title: Depression Prediction with Explainable AI
description: Comparative study of ML and DL models for predicting depression among university students, with XAI integration for clinical interpretability and responsible deployment.
